issues.title: Helper methods marked public inappropriately
issues.description: Helper methods checkUrl(), copyUrl(), and checkCopiedUrl() are marked public but are only used internally within the ClipBoardTests class. They should be marked private to minimize exposure of internal implementation details.
issues.rule_name: Properties and Methods Must Have Appropriate Access Control

issues.title: Missing clipboard verification after copy operation
issues.description: The testClipboard() method copies the URL but skips the checkCopiedUrl() verification step that validates the clipboard contents match the expected URL. This test previously verified that the copied URL in the clipboard matches the browser's URL bar value, ensuring the copy operation worked correctly. Without this check, the test cannot detect if the copy operation failed or if the clipboard contains incorrect data, allowing clipboard-related bugs to pass undetected.

func testClipboard() {
        navigator.openURL(url)
        waitUntilPageLoad()
        checkUrl()
        copyUrl()

        navigator.createNewTab()

issues.title: Incorrect UI element verification for light theme selection
issues.description: After selecting light theme mode via Action.SelectLightTheme, the test verifies the wrong UI element by checking darkThemeView instead of lightThemeView. This causes the test to validate dark theme selection state when it should be verifying light theme was properly selected. The bug means the test will fail when light theme is correctly selected (darkThemeView will be '0' not '1'), or pass incorrectly if light theme selection fails but dark theme happens to be selected.
issues.problematic_code_snippet:
// Select Light mode
        navigator.performAction(Action.SelectLightTheme)
        let lightIsSelected = app.buttons[AccessibilityIdentifiers.Settings.Appearance.darkThemeView].value
        XCTAssertEqual(lightIsSelected as? String, "1")

issues.title: Navigation timing issue in settings toggle verification
issues.description: The test taps the 'Done' button before navigating to NewTabScreen, reversing the correct order of operations. The navigator.goto(NewTabScreen) call expects to transition from the settings screen, but 'Done' has already been tapped which dismisses the settings UI. This creates a race condition where the navigation command may fail or behave unpredictably because it's operating on an already-dismissed screen. The correct flow should be navigate first, then tap Done to confirm the navigation completed.

issues.title: Public methods lack required documentation comments
issues.description: The helper methods checkUrl(), copyUrl(), and checkCopiedUrl() were changed from internal to public visibility in this PR. According to AGENTS.md Rule 14, all public API elements must include triple-slash (///) documentation comments describing their purpose, behavior, parameters, and return values. These methods only have single-line comments (// Comment) instead of proper documentation comments (/// Comment). This violates the repository's explicit compliance rules for public APIs.

pr.title: Code Review Bench PR #31612 - [MTE-5149] - delete auto tests

structured_output.summary:
This PR removes several XCUITests marked for deletion: `ClipBoardTests.testCopyLink` (already mostly commented out), `HomePageSettingsUITests.testSetCustomURLAsHome` (already skipped with `XCTSkipIf(true)`), and the matching entries in four `.xctestplan` files. It also changes `DisplaySettingTests.testCheckSystemThemeChanges` (new TestRail ID and a selector edit), reorders two statements in `testDisableTopSitesSettingsRemovesSection`, and makes three `ClipBoardTests` helpers `public`. The deletions are clean. I found no remaining references to the removed tests in the repo, and the test-plan edits match the deleted methods.

The edit to `testCheckSystemThemeChanges` is broken. After selecting Light, the assertion reads the dark-theme button and expects "1", but that button should be "0" in light mode. The test will fail on every run. The PR description also says a new test case was created, but the diff only edits the existing test. The `checkCopiedUrl()` assertion is silently dropped from `testClipboard`, which is a live smoketest. Together these mean the PR is not ready to merge as written.
structured_output.verdictRationale: The wrong element in `testCheckSystemThemeChanges` makes a test that was touched in this PR fail deterministically, so it adds a red test rather than removing one. The silently removed assertion in `testClipboard` and the mismatch with the PR description are secondary but should be explained or fixed. The deletions themselves are sound.

architecture.overview:
The XCUITest suite lives under `firefox-ios/firefox-ios-tests/Tests/XCUITests`. Each test class extends `BaseTestCase` and drives the app through a `navigator`. Four `.xctestplan` files under `firefox-ios/firefox-ios-tests/Tests/` act as the registries that decide which test identifiers run in each lane (Accessibility, FullFunctional, Smoketest, TAESmokeTest). A test that is deleted from a class but left in a plan will fail the lane, so the class and the plans must change together.

This PR deletes three test methods and the plan entries that point at them. It also edits one test's body and reorders two statements in another. The plan edits are one-for-one with the deleted methods. The body edits are not all intentional: one changes the selector to the wrong theme button, and one drops an assertion.
steps: Entry point: each `.xctestplan` lists test identifiers such as `ClipBoardTests/testClipboard()`. The lane runs only what is listed.

Deleted methods: `ClipBoardTests.testCopyLink` and `HomePageSettingsUITests.testSetCustomURLAsHome`. The second was already skipped with `XCTSkipIf(true)`, so no coverage is lost. The matching plan entries are removed in all four plans.

Edited body: `DisplaySettingTests.testCheckSystemThemeChanges` now uses a new TestRail ID. Its Light-mode assertion queries `darkThemeView`, which is incorrect and will fail. The intended selector is `lightThemeView`.
Reordered body: in `testDisableTopSitesSettingsRemovesSection`, the Done tap now runs before `navigator.goto(NewTabScreen)`. The PR description does not explain this.
Dropped assertion: `testClipboard` no longer calls `checkCopiedUrl()`. That helper is also no longer called anywhere live, and its only remaining reference is inside a commented-out block.

findings.title: testCheckSystemThemeChanges asserts the wrong theme button after selecting Light
findings.fixPrompt: In `firefox-ios/firefox-ios-tests/Tests/XCUITests/DisplaySettingsTests.swift`, `testCheckSystemThemeChanges` (around lines 53-54) reads `AccessibilityIdentifiers.Settings.Appearance.darkThemeView` into `lightIsSelected` right after `Action.SelectLightTheme`. Change that selector to `lightThemeView` so the assertion checks the Light button, as the variable name and the step intend. Keep the Dark and Automatic checks unchanged. Follow the selector usage in `testCheckDisplaySettingsDefault` in the same file.

findings.title: PR description says a new test was created, but the diff only edits an existing test
findings.fixPrompt: Reconcile the PR description with the diff for `DisplaySettingsTests.swift`. The description says a new `testCheckSystemThemeChanges` was created and only the old one deleted, but the diff edits the existing method in place. Confirm the TestRail case `3298823` is the intended replacement for `2337487`. Then either update the PR description to say the existing test was edited, or add the missing new test method. Check the TestRail link at the top of `testCheckSystemThemeChanges` (around line 46).

findings.title: testClipboard silently loses its pasteboard assertion
findings.fixPrompt: In `firefox-ios/firefox-ios-tests/Tests/XCUITests/ClipBoardTests.swift`, `testClipboard` (around lines 66-70) no longer calls `checkCopiedUrl()` after `copyUrl()`. This PR removed that call without explanation. Either restore `checkCopiedUrl()` between `copyUrl()` and `navigator.createNewTab()`, or if the removal is intentional, document the reason in a comment on `testClipboard` and in the PR description. Note that `checkCopiedUrl` is a no-op on iOS 16+, so the removal only changes behaviour on iOS 15 and earlier.

findings.title: Helpers made `public` without need in an internal test class
findings.fixPrompt: In `firefox-ios/firefox-ios-tests/Tests/XCUITests/ClipBoardTests.swift`, the helpers `checkUrl()` (line 11), `copyUrl()` (line 17) and `checkCopiedUrl()` (line 41) were changed to `public func` in this PR. Revert them to plain `func`, matching the other helpers in the XCUITest target and the `ClipBoardTests` class, which is internal. Nothing in this PR needs the wider access.

findings.title: checkCopiedUrl is now dead code
findings.fixPrompt: In `firefox-ios/firefox-ios-tests/Tests/XCUITests/ClipBoardTests.swift`, `checkCopiedUrl()` (around line 41) is no longer called by any live test. The only reference left is in the commented-out body of `testClipboardPasteAndGo` (around line 102). Decide whether this helper is still needed. If `testClipboardPasteAndGo` is not coming back, delete the helper and the commented reference. If it is, keep the helper and add a comment saying why it is retained.

findings.title: Unexplained reordering in testDisableTopSitesSettingsRemovesSection
findings.fixPrompt: In `firefox-ios/firefox-ios-tests/Tests/XCUITests/HomePageSettingsUITest.swift`, `testDisableTopSitesSettingsRemovesSection` (around lines 151-158) now taps the Done button before calling `navigator.goto(NewTabScreen)`. The original order was the reverse, and this PR does not explain the change. Confirm whether the new order is required for the test to pass. If it is, add a short comment explaining why. If it is not, restore the original order. Either way, mention it in the PR description.

findings.title: Deleted tests and plan entries are consistent
findings.body: The deletions are clean. Repo-wide grep finds no remaining `testSetCustomURLAsHome` or `ClipBoardTests/testCopyLink` references. `NavigationTest.testCopyLink` is a separate method and is untouched. The `testSetCustomURLAsHome` method was already skipped with `XCTSkipIf(true)` for issue 28117, so removing it loses no active coverage. The matching plan entries are removed from all four `.xctestplan` files, so no lane will look for a missing test.
